instructions:
Notes: • Do not join at end of rnds. • Work in spiral in continuous rnds, unless otherwise stated. • Move marker onto first st at beg of each rnd.
Body
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM on first st. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
5th to 13th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Stuff Body firmly. Cont stuffing while working rest of Body.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
15th and 16th rnds: *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts at end of 16th rnd.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.

Legs (Make 4 alike).
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off C.
3rd rnd: Join MC with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. PM in first st. Do not join. Cont working in spiral in continuous rnds.
4th to 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Stuff Leg firmly.

Head
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM in first st. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th to 12th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes between 9th and 10th rnds, approx 11 sts apart.
Stuff Head firmly. Cont stuffing while working rest of Head.
13th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
14th and 15th rnds: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts at end of 15th rnd.
Fasten off, leaving long tail. Draw tail through rem sts and pull tight to close.

Neck
With MC, and leaving a long tail for sewing, ch 14. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.

Ears (Make 2 alike).
With MC, ch 7.
1st row: Working in ‘bumps’ on back of chains, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.

Mane
Front Piece: With A, ch 6.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each ch to end of chain. 15 sc.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Short Piece: With C, ch 10.
1st row: Work as given for Front Piece. 27 sc.
Medium Piece: With A, ch 12.
1st row: Work as given for Front Piece. 33 sc.
Long Piece: With B, ch 14.
1st row: Work as given for Front Piece. 39 sc.

Tail (Make 1 each in A, B, and C).
Ch 27.
1st row: Working in ‘bump’ at back of chains, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain.
Fasten off.

Horn
With C, leaving long beg tail for sewing, ch 4. Sl st in first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in ring. Do not join. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM on first st.
2nd and 3rd rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 3 sts.
5th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sts.
Fasten off. Do not stuff Horn.

FINISHING
With long tails, assemble pieces as follows:
Fold Ears in half so tops of sts and ch face front. Stitch through base of ear to secure fold. Sew Ears to top of Head in 14th rnd, approx 3 sts apart.
Sew Horn to top of head, centered between and just in front of Ears.
Sew Neck to underside of Head, over 9th to 14th rnds.
Stuff Neck firmly. Sew Neck and Head to Body, beg at 4th rnd of Body, with Head facing forward.
Sew Legs to bottom of Body, with back Legs beg at 10th rnd of Body and front Legs beg at 6th rnd, with 1 rnd between front and back Legs. Note: Both front and back Legs should touch.
Sew Front Piece of Mane to top of Head, between Ears.
Sew rem Mane pieces to back of Head, with Short Piece at the top and Long Piece at bottom.
Hold all three Tail pieces tog and fold in half. With tail from Body, sew Tail pieces to rear of Body at fold.

©2013 Coats & Clark
Flowered Wedding Favor Box
Crochet these little flowers for a beautiful personal touch on gifts from the bride to wedding party or guests. For other occasions, do them in bright or pastel colors and use wherever you wish.
Notes
All pieces are crocheted in joined rounds; do not turn unless otherwise indicated.
Flower is crocheted in 2 parts, then sewn together and tied to lid of gift box.
FLOWER
Petals
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 2, work 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc, tighten beginning tail to close center – 10 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 5, sc, ch 1) in first st, [skip next st, (sc, ch 5, sc, ch 1) in next st] 4 times; join with slip st in first st – 5 petals.
Round 3: Ch 1, [(sc, hdc, 4 dc, ch 2, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in next ch-5 space] 5 times; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.
Flower Center
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 2, [sc, ch 3] 5 times in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first st to create mini flower shape, tighten beginning tail to close center – 5 sc, 5 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: [Ch 2, (dc, tr, ch 1, tr, dc) in next ch-3 space, ch 2, slip st in next sc] 5 times – 5 petals. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Using photo as a guide, sew Flower Center to Flower Petal, leaving tails to attach piece to box. Weave in remaining ends. Wrap box lid with ribbon as desired. Poke small holes in lid. Thread tails through holes and tie Flower Trim securely to lid. Flower Trim may also be tied or sewn to ribbon, if desired.
Designed by Andee Graves

instructions:
If she wants to be a princess, you can complete her look in royal style with this long braided wig. First a hat-like wig and flowers are crocheted. Then the lengths of “hair” are added for an irresistibly cute princess.
All Sizes
Rounds 8-10 (9-12): Ch 3, (ch 1, hdc in next space) around, join with sc to first hdc.
Round 11 (13): Ch 1 (counts as first sc, now and throughout), sc in each hdc and ch-1 space around, join with slip st to first sc— 60(64) sc.
Round 12 (14): Ch 1, (sc2tog, sc in next 4(6) sc) around to last sc, skip last sc, join with slip st to first sc— 50(56) sc.
Rounds 13 and 14 (15 and 16): Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st to first sc, fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Small Flower (Make 2 in colors of your choice)
Leaving a 4” (10 cm), and with smaller size hook, ch 5; join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right side): Ch 1, 10 sc in ring, join with slip st to first sc— 10 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same stitch, ch 3, skip next sc, *sc in next, ch 3, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first sc—: 5 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, *slip st in next ch-3 sp, (3 hdc, sc, slip st) in same ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first slip st; fasten off.
Large Flower (Make 4 in colors of your choice)
Leaving a 4” (10 cm), and with smaller size hook, ch 5; join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right side): Ch 1, 10 sc in ring, join with slip st to first sc— 10 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same stitch, ch 3, skip next sc, *sc in next, ch 3, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first sc— 5 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, *slip st in next ch-3 sp, (sc, 3 hdc, sc, slip st) in same ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first slip st.
Directions are for size Small; changes for size Medium are in parentheses
WIG
With A and larger size hook, ch 4; join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right side): Ch 3 (counts as hdc plus ch 1, now and throughout), hdc in ring, (ch 1, hdc in ring) 6 times, join with sc to first hdc— 8 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 3, hdc in same space, ch 1, hdc in next space, *ch 1, hdc in next space, ch 1, hdc in same space, ch 1, hdc in next space; repeat from * around; join with sc to first hdc— 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Repeat Round 2: 18 ch-1 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 3, hdc in same space, (ch 1, hdc in next space) twice, *ch 1, hdc in next space, ch 1, hdc in same space, (ch 1, hdc in next space) twice; repeat from * around; join with sc to first hdc— 24 ch-1 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 3, (ch 1, hdc in next space) around, join with sc to first hdc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Repeat Rounds 4 and 5— 30 ch-1 spaces.
Size Medium Only
Round 8: Ch 3, hdc in same space, *(ch 1, hdc in next space) 14 times, ch 1, hdc in next space, ch 1, hdc in same space; repeat from * around, join with sc to first hdc— 32 ch-1 spaces.
Round 4: With right side facing, join next color with sc in any skipped sc on Round 1; ch 5, (sc in next skipped sc, ch 5) around, join with slip st to first sc— 5 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 1, *slip st in next ch-5 space, (sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc, slip st) in same ch-5 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first slip st; fasten off.
FINISHING
Wig
Cut elastic to fit head circumference allowing an additional ½” (12.7 mm), overlapping ends ½” (12.7 mm). With sewing needle and matching thread, sew ends together forming a circle. With wrong side of Wig facing, place elastic around edge of Wig, folding Round 14 (16) over elastic. With sewing needle and matching thread, sew Round 14 (16) to Wig, securing elastic.
Hair
Cut 39, 102” (259 cm) lengths of D for hair. With crochet hook and using photo as a guide, loop 13 lengths of D around hdc posts of Wig beginning at Round 14 (16) to form hair. Repeat for Rounds 13 (15) and 12 (14) of Wig. Thread yarn needle with a length of D. Beginning at Round 1 of Wig, weave length through hdc posts in concentric circles to last 3 rounds, then weave yarn back and forth under remaining posts on final 3 rounds.
Tack third row of hair in place by taking one strand of each pair of hair and slipping it under woven base. Style remaining 2 rows of hair in desired shaping, pulling all strands back loosely to form a ponytail at back neck. Cut one 18” (45.5 cm) strand of A and one 18” (45.5 cm) strand of C for hair ties, fold each strand in half and set aside. Tie hair with doubled strand of A. Divide ponytail into 3 groups of 26 strands each and braid loosely. Tie end of braid with doubled strand of C. Trim hair ends even. Using photo as a guide and long yarn ends, tie flowers onto hair.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph and assembly diagram, arrange crocheted beads into a cluster, with less tidy ends of beads in the center. With a length of crochet thread, sew beads together. sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

instructions:
Roof 
With A and larger hook, ch 13. 
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc. Place marker on last st.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 4 times more. 2 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Roof edging: 1st rnd: (RS). With larger hook, join B with sl st in marked st. Work 12 sl st evenly across shaped side of rows (lower edge of Roof). Sl st up straight side to Point. Ch 14 for hanging loop and sl st back into same sp as last sl st. Sl st down foundation ch. Join with sl st to first sl st.
Change to smaller hook.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Skip next sl st. *5 hdc in next sl st. Skip next sl st. Sl st in next sl st. Skip next sl st. Rep from * once more. 5 hdc in back loop of next sl st. Skip next sl st. Sl st in back loop of next sl st. Fasten off.

Running Stitch
French Knots
Roof Embroidery: With B, work running st embroidery across lower edges of 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th and 10th rows. With C, D, E and F work French knots evenly spaced as shown between running st embroidery.
House
With A and larger hook, ch 13. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 6 times more (8 rows total). Fasten off.
House edging: With RS facing and larger hook, join B with sl st in top left corner. Sl st evenly down side, across foundation row and up opposite side to corner. Fasten off. Leave top edge unworked.
Heart
With C and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
First Hump: Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 2 sc. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Second Hump: Next row: (WS). Join C with sl st to next unworked sc. Ch 1. Sc2tog over same st as last sl st and next st. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 2 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Sew Heart in position as shown. Sew Roof to House.

instructions:
Making this easy pillow is a great way to relax and focus on crochet while taking a break from the world. The result is a pillow that will add comfort in whatever room you use it.

Notes:
1. Pillow cover is made from two pieces. Both pieces are worked back and forth in rows with two strands of yarn held together throughout.
2. Yarn color is changed to create stripes. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Do not cut old color until instructed. Carry color not in use carefully up side edge when next needed.
3. Fringe is attached to a ridge on front of the pillow cover and tassels are attached to all four corners.
4. Keep pillow form handy. As you work, compare size of each of the two pieces with pillow form. If a piece is too large or too small, adjust the size by adding or subtracting the number of beginning chains and/or number of rows worked.

Special Stitch:
Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. Skip the top of the stitch "behind" the Fpdc.

PILLOW COVER PIECES (make 2):
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 42. 
Row 1 (right side): With A, working in back bumps only, dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped ch count as first dc), dc in each remaining ch across—40 dc. 
Row 2: With A, ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in next st, Fpdc around each of next 36 sts, hdc in next st, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 and change to 2 strands of B held together—4 hdc and 36 post sts.
Row 3: With B, ch 3, turn, dc in each st across, dc in top of beginning ch-2—40 dc.
Row 4: With B, ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in next st, Fpdc around each of next 36 sts, hdc in next st, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 and change to 2 strands of A held together.
Row 5: With A, ch 3, turn, dc in each st across, dc in top of beginning ch-2.
Rows 6–9: Repeat Rows 2–5.
Rows 10–12: Repeat Rows 2–4.
Rows 13 and 14: With A, ch 3, turn, dc in each st across, dc in top of beginning ch-2 and change to 2 strands of B held together at the end of Row 14.
Rows 15 and 16: Repeat Rows 3 and 4. Place a marker in ridge just made on right side of piece (for tassel placement).
Row 17: Repeat Row 5.
Rows 18–25: Repeat Rows 2–5 twice.
Row 26: Repeat Row 2.
Fasten off A. Do not fasten off B.

Edging Round: With B, ch 1, work sc stitches as evenly spaced as possible along all 4 sides of piece, working 3 sc in each corner. Take care to work the same number of sc along each side; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

FINISHING:
Seaming: Hold the two pieces together with stripes running in the same direction, stitches matching and wrong sides facing inwards. With right side facing you and with 2 strands of B held together, working in inner loops of both pieces at the same time, join yarn with slip st in any edging st, slip st in each remaining edging st all the way around, and insert pillow form before completing seam. Fasten off.

Fringe:
Cut 1 strand each of A, B, and C, each 5" [12.5 cm] long. Fold strands in half to form a loop. Insert crochet hook from bottom through back most loop of first stitch in marked ridge on front of pillow cover. Place fold on hook and draw fold through, forming a loop. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten. Repeat to attach fringe in every other stitch across ridge. Trim ends evenly.

Tassels (make 4):
Holding 1 strand each of A, B, and C together, wrap yarn about 10 times around 5" (12.5 cm) piece of heavy cardboard. Thread a 10" (25.5 cm) single strand of any of the yarn colors under the top of the wraps and tie into a tight knot for top of tassel. Do not trim the ends of the tie. Slip wraps off of cardboard. Tie a 10" (25.5 cm) length of yarn around wraps about ¾" (19 mm) from top for tassel neck. Wrap ends of tie around wraps about 6 times and then draw ends to inside of tassel. Cut the lower ends of the wraps and trim to even. Use yarn needle and ends of tie at top of tassel to sew one tassel securely to each of the four corners.

Weave in ends.

Hairpin Lace Vest
We’ve combined two shades of soft, shiny 
Shimmer for this easy-to-wear vest. Pattern 
is written for a wide range of sizes using the 
hairpin lace technique. See our video to learn 
how, or as a refresher.
Directions are written for size Small with 
changes for sizes Medium, Large, X-Large, 
XX-Large, and XXX-Large in parentheses.
Finished Measurements
Bust: 36 (40, 44, 48, 52, 56)” (91.5 (101.5, 
112, 122, 132, 142) cm)
Length: 23” (58.5 cm) 
Special Stitch
sc2tog (single crochet 2 together) = [Draw 
up a loop in next st] 2 times, yarn over and 
draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Notes
1. Small, Medium, and Large jackets are
made from two long strips and one
back strip. See assembly diagram for
arrangement of strips.
2. X-Large, XX-Large, and XXX-Large jackets
are made from two long strips, a center
back strip, and two shorter side strips.
See assembly diagram for arrangement of
strips.
3. Sleeves are worked directly into armhole
openings.
4. When instructed to work evenly across the
ends of rows, work as follows: Work 1 sc
in the end of each sc row, 2 sc in the end
of each dc row, 5 sc in each row that ends
with a hairpin lace loop, and 1 slip st in the
center of each hairpin lace strip.
JACKET
Hairpin Lace Strips
Note: Before removing loops from loom, 
thread a length of yarn under all loops on one 
side of loom. Repeat for second side. This will 
assist in keeping the loops organized and in 
place. Keep the lengths in place until the strip 
edging is complete.
Long Strips (make 2): With A, make strip of 
hairpin lace with 138 loops on each side of the 
sts = 4” in double crochet. CHECK 
YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook 
to obtain the gauge.
RED HEART® 
Shimmer®, Art. E763 
available in 3.5 oz 
(100 g), 280 yd  
(256 m) balls
Design by Tammy Hildebrand
What you will need:
RED HEART® Shimmer®: 2 (3, 3, 
3, 4, 4) balls 1929 1503 Turquoise 
A, 2 (2, 3, 3, 3, 4) balls 1945 
Peacock B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook:  
5.5 mm [US I-9]
Susan Bates® Adjustable Hairpin 
Lace Loom set to 4” (10 cm)
Sewing needle and matching 
thread, one 11⁄8” (28 mm) shank 
button, yarn needle
GAUGE: One strip with edging 
(before assembly) measures 5½ 
(5½, 5½, 5½, 6, 6)” (14 (14, 14, 
14, 15, 15) cm) wide; 16 rows = 
4” (10 cm) in single crochet; 12 
strip. Carefully remove each strip from loom 
(see Note). Strip should measure about 46” 
(117 cm) long.
Back Strip: With A, make strip of hairpin lace 
with 66 loops on each side of the strip. 
Carefully remove strip from loom. Strip should 
measure about 22” (46 cm) long.
Sizes X-Large (XX-Large, XXX-Large) Only 
Side Strips (make 2): With A, make strip of 
hairpin lace with 42 loops on each side of strip. 
Carefully remove each strip from loom. Strip 
should measure about 14” (35.5 cm) long.

Work edging across both long edges of all 
strips.
Row 1: With right side of strip facing and B, 
insert hook under first 6 loops of one side edge 
of strip, ch 3 (counts as first dc); holding all 
loops together as one, work 5 dc in the 6 loops 
(first shell made), *insert hook in next 6 loops; 
holding all loops together as one, work 6 dc in 
the 6 loops (shell made); repeat from * across 
edge. Fasten off. Remove lengths of yarn 
(placed when removing strip from loom) from 
loops.
Row 2: With right side facing, join A with sc in 
first st, ch 3, working in back loops only, skip 
next st, sc in next 2 sts, ch 3, skip next 2 sts, 
*sc in next space between shells, ch 3, skip
next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts, ch 3; repeat from *
across to last shell, skip next 2 sts, sc in next
2 sts, ch 3, skip next st, sc in last st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in each
ch-3 space and sc across, turn.
Sizes XX-Large, and XXX-Large Only
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across. 
All Sizes
Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Sew Back Seams: Arrange strips as shown 
in assembly diagram. Hold strips with wrong 
sides together, with A whipstitch both long 
edges of center back strip to long strips.
Long Side Edgings
Work side edging across both outer long 
edges of assembled piece.
Row 1: With right side facing, join B with sc in 
first st, sc in each st across, turn.
Next 2 (6, 10, 7, 7, 15) Rows: Ch 1, sc in each 
st across, turn.
Fasten off.
Sizes Small (Medium, Large) Only
Fold assembled piece in half across shoulder 
line. Place markers on front and back side 
edges, 8 (8, 8½)” (20.5 (20.5, 21.5) cm) down 
from shoulder line for armhole placement.

sc in first st, sc in each st to first marker, turn; 
leave remaining sts unworked for armhole.
Next 2 (6, 10) Short Rows: Ch 1, sc in each st 
across, turn.
Fasten off. Remove armhole markers.

shoulder line, bringing wrong sides together. 
Sizes Small (Medium, Large) Only
On each side, beginning at lower edge, 
whipstitch stitches of last short row to stitches 
at opposite end of the same long strip.
Sizes X-Large (XX-Large, XXX-Large) Only
On each side, beginning at lower edge, 
whipstitch edges of long strip to edges of  
side strip.
Front Edging
Row 1: With right side facing, join B with sc 
in lower front corner to work up front edge, 
sc evenly spaced up front edge, across back 
neck, and down other front edge to opposite 
front corner, turn.
Next 3 (3, 3, 3, 5, 5) Rows: Ch 1, sc in each sc 
across, turn.
Fasten off.
SLEEVES (make 2)
Sizes Small (Medium, Large) Only
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, 
join A with sc in end of first row at beginning 
of underarm, sc in end of each row at 
underarm, sc in each st around armhole 
opening; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across underarm, 
dc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with 
slip st in first sc.
Repeat last 2 rounds five times. 
Fasten off.
Sizes X-Large (XX-Large, XXX-Large) Only
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, 
join A with sc in end of first row at beginning 
of underarm, work 7 more sc evenly spaced 
across ends of rows to center of underarm 
strip, slip st in center of strip, work 8 sc evenly 
spaced across ends of rows of remainder 
of underarm, sc in each st around armhole 
opening; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, 
sc2tog, sc in next sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 
slip st, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc 
in next sc, dc in each st around; join with slip 
st in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with 
slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc, dc in each st 
around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 5: Repeat Round 3.
Repeat last 2 rounds four times. 
Fasten off.

Lower Edging
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, join 
A with sc in end of row at lower front corner 
to work across lower edge of vest, sc evenly 
spaced across lower edge to opposite corner, 
turn. 
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in each st across.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends. With sewing needle and 
thread, sew button to left front edge, using 
photograph as a guide for placement.
Buttonloop: With right side facing, join B with 
slip st in right front edge, opposite button, ch 
7, slip st in same st as joining, ch 1, slip st in 
each ch of the ch-7. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
GARLAND
Center: With A, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring; ch 1, (sc, 4 hdc) all into ring, drop A, DO NOT FASTEN OFF; following the A sts, join B with an sc in the ring, work 4 hdc into same ring, drop B, DO NOT FASTEN OFF.
Rnd 1: Pick up A, work 2 hdc into each B st – 10 hdc A; drop A, pick up B, work 2 hdc in each A st – 30 hdc B, drop B.
Rnd 2: Pick up A, 2 dc in next 10 hdc, hdc in next hdc, * hdc in next hdc, sc in next hdc, slip st in next hdc, ch 5 *; fasten off A leaving a long end to sew loop; pick up B, 2 hdc in next hdc; repeat from * to * across next 3 hdc; fasten off B leaving a long end to sew loop.
Make 9 more pieces with your choice of A+C, B+C, or A+B.
CONNECTING GARLAND PIECES
First Piece: Thread yarn needle with long end left after ch-5 and stitch into coaster near beginning of the chain to make a loop; secure yarn on wrong side. Repeat on opposite side of coaster.
Join 2nd Piece: Thread yarn needle with long end left after ch-5 of 2nd piece, weave through a finished loop, stitch into coaster near beginning of this chain; secure yarn. Complete a loop on opposite side of coaster.
Continue until all pieces are joined. Additional pieces can be added to make garland longer if desired. 
JINGLE BELL FRINGE
Thread three bells onto A; ch 1, pull first bell up to first ch, make a ch over bell, continue to ch for total of 13”, pull 2nd bell up, ch 3, pull 3rd bell up, ch 2. Fasten off. Tie in bow around joining loops.
Weave in ends.

Row 4 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 3, 
skip next 2 unworked sc of Row 3, sc in next sc, 
TURN and work sc in each ch of the ch-3 just 
made, slip st in the next sc (one cable made), 
TURN; working behind the cable, sc in each of 
the 2 skipped sc; repeat from * across to last 
sc, sc in last sc of Row 3, turn—16 cables.
Note: In the next row, you will work a sc in 
the first and last st, and 3 sc evenly spaced 
behind each cable. The 3 sc behind each 
cable are worked into the sc that were worked 
into the 2 skipped sc. Work sc in one of these 
skipped sc and 2 sc into the other. Push the 
cables towards the right side of the throw as 
you work. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *2 sc in next sc, sc 
in next sc; repeat from * across to last sc, sc 
in last sc, turn—50 sc.
Front Ridge Pattern
Row 6 (right side): Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: Ch 1, working in free loops of sts of

in last st, turn—13 repeats.
Row 9: Ch 2, dc in first dc, *skip next 3 dc, tr 
in next tr, working in front of tr just made, dc 
in each of 3 skipped dc; repeat from * across 
to last st, dc in last st, turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, [sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 8 yards each 01 White and 12 Black
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 1.5mm [US-7 Steel Hook]
Sequins of various sizes & shapes in any desired colors
Small amount of fiber fill stuffing
measurements: Earrings measure 1¾” (4.5 cm) tall and 17⁄16” (3.5 cm) wide.
gauge: Rounds 1-4 = 7⁄8” (2 cm). Gauge is not critical, fabric needs to be firm.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com
©2012 Coats & Clark
RedHeart.com
Day of the Dead 
Earrings
Whether you’re observing the Day of the Dead 
or Halloween, the skulls on these earrings 
add just the right touch. The findings for 
constructing the earrings are as close as your 
local craft store.

3 sc in next st, sc next 2 sts, sc2tog over next 
2 sts, sc next 3 sts, 2 sc next st, [sc in next 5 
sts, 2 sc in next st] 2 times; join with slip st in 
first sc – 50 sc and 2 sc2tog.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Embellish Skulls
Using photo as a guide, embroider mouths and 
noses on skulls with second color. To make 
eyes, sew sequins in place with one seed 
bead in center of each sequin with beading 
thread and needle to make eyes.
Using second color, sew 2 skulls Wrong Sides 
together with whipstitch around edges. Lightly 
stuff and sew jump ring firmly in place at top 
of skull. Use pliers to connect earring wires to 
jump ring.

EARRINGS
Skull (Make 2 in each color)
Round 1: Starting with first color, make an 
adjustable slip knot, ch 2, work 7 sc in 2nd 
ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc; pull 
beginning yarn tail to close center – 7 sc.

Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join 
with slip st in first sc – 14 sc.

Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 7 
times; join with slip st in first sc – 21 sc.

Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next 
st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.

Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next 
st] 2 times, sc in next 4 sts, (sc, ch 1, dc) in 
next st, dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 
st, (dc, ch 1, sc) in next st, sc next 2 sts, 2 
sc next st, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 2 
times; join with slip st in first sc – 30 sc, 6 dc 
and 2 ch-1 spaces.

Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next 
st] 2 times, sc next 3 sts, sc2tog over next 2 
sts, sc in ch-1, (sc, hdc, dc) in next st, dc in 
next 4 sts, (dc, hdc, sc) next st, sc next ch-1, 
sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc next 2 sts, 2 sc next 
st, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 2 times; 
join with slip st in first sc – 35 sc, 2 sc2tog, 2 
hdc and 6 dc.

Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 
st] 2 times, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog over next 2 
sts, sc next 2 sts, 3 sc next st, sc in next 4 sts.

pattern_name: Whale Of A Time Crochet Romper
materials: Bernat® Softee Baby™ (5 oz/140 g; 362 yds/331 m)
Sizes U.S. C/2 (3.25 mm) and U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or sizes needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: To fit chest measurement: 6 mos 17" [43 cm]; 12 mos 18" [45.5 cm]; 18 mos 19" [48.5 cm]
gauge: 16 hdc and 11.5 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• Romper is worked in one piece beginning at front neck and working down.
• Body section is worked in the round, turning at end of each round to maintain consistent texture with sections that are worked flat.
• Whale Applique is worked on smaller hook and sewn on during Finishing.

ROMPER
Front Bib: Beg at neck edge, with larger hook and B, ch 20 (20-24).
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 18 (18-22) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 2 (3-3) times more. 24 (26-28) hdc.
Next 2 (2-4) rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
1st rnd: Make Back and Join Front Bib: (WS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Ch 40 (44-44) for Back. Join with sl st to first hdc to create rnd (taking care not to twist ch). Turn.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 40 (44-44) ch. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. 64 (70-72) hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 7 (6-5) hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 (6-5) hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join A with sl st to first hdc 2. 72 (80-84) hdc. Turn.
Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows, taking care to maintain color changes and carry unused color up WS of work:
Next 2 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. Join B at end of 2nd rnd.
Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. Join A at end of 2nd rnd.
Next 2 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. Join B at end of 2nd rnd.
Rep last 4 rnds once more.
Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. Join A at end of 2nd rnd. Break B.
Next rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. Rep last rnd until work from first rnd where Back chain is joined measures 6½ (7-8)" [16.5 (18-20.5) cm], ending on WS rnd. Fasten off.
Divide for crotch: Lay piece flat with Bib in center and place markers in last rnd on each side.
Back Panel: 1st row: (RS). Skip first 4 (5-5) hdc from side marker. Join A with sl st to next hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as join. 1 hdc in each of next 27 (29-31) hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 3 (4-4) times more. 20 (20-22) sts.
Next row:  Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Rep last row 3 times more. 12 (12-14) sts.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Back Panel section measures 6 (7-8)" [15 (18-20.5) cm]. Fasten off.
Front Panel: 1st row: (RS). Skip next 8 (10-10) hdc after Back Panel. Join A with sl st to next hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as join. 1 hdc in each of next 27 (29-31) hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 1 (2-2) time(s) more. 24 (24-26) sts.
Next row:  Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Rep last row 5 times more. 12 (12-14) sts.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Front Panel section measures approx 4½ (5-6)" [11.5 (12.5-15) cm], ending on a RS row. Do not fasten off.
Cont as follows for Left Leg edging: (RS). Work 1 row of sc evenly along edge of Left Leg opening to bottom edge of Back Panel. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join A with sl st to opposite corner of Back Panel and work 1 row of sc evenly along edge of Right Leg opening to bottom edge of Front Panel. Fasten off.
Straps (make 2-worked lengthwise)
With A and larger hook,  ch 40 (44-48).
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 38 (42-46) hdc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of 3rd row.
FINISHING
Sew ends of Straps in position to Back, positioning 3 (3½-3½)" [7.5 (9-9) cm] between Straps at center back. Cross Straps at back and sew 2 buttons on end of each Strap 1" [2.5 cm] apart, using space between sts on Front Bib for buttonholes. Sew 3 buttons evenly spaced along end of Back Panel. Use space between sts on Front Panel for buttonholes.
Whale Applique
Body: With A and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker on first sc. Do not join rnds.
2nd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 11 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 17 sc.
Make tail fin: Sl st in next sc. Ch 6. 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Ch 2. Sl st back into last ch. Ch 3. 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Ch 2. Sl st back into last ch.
Working along opposite side of rem ch, sl st in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Working into Body sts, 1 sc in same sp where last sl st of Body was worked. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next st. Sl st in each of next 3 sts. Fasten off.
Stretch Applique slightly widthwise to lengthen and create whale shape.
With B, embroider eye using French knot and mouth using backstitch.
Sew Applique in position on Front Bib as shown in photo.

instructions:

With MC, ch 12. Join with sl st to form ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 24 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with B with sl st to first sc. 48 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 54 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from 7th rnd measures 7 ins [18 cm]. 
Fasten off. 
Quit Smoking Version: “No Smoking” Sign 
With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with A with sl st to first sc. 64 sc. 
9th rnd: With A, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. *1 dc in each of next 3 sc. 2 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 dc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.

These colorful crocheted goldfish motifs are perfectly suited to the household with feline members. Or display this throw at a beachside home and be ready for foggy days and chilly evenings.
Note: Make sure that eye is placed properly so that fish in D are facing to the left and fish in C are facing to the right. 
Fin: Ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, 5 hdc in last ch, working down other side of foundation ch, slip st in next ch, slip st in first st, join, fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
With yarn needle using running stitch, sew fin to center of body using opposite color fin as body color and point of fin facing to the back. Sew fish to center of each solid color square. Assemble squares rows 5 across and 5 down using sc to join rows on wrong side of throw as follows: Rows 1, 3, 5: Half A/B square with B triangle to lower left, solid square, half A/B square with B triangle to upper right, solid square, half A/B square with B triangle to lower left. Note: The fish for these rows will be D facing to the left. Rows 2, 4: Solid square, half A/B square with B triangle to lower right, solid square, half A/B square with B triangle to upper left, solid square. Note: The fish for these rows will be C facing to the right.
See assembly diagram
BORDER
Round 1: With E, sc evenly around, working 3 sc in each corner, join with slip st to first sc, fasten off.
SQUARES 
(make 12 in A and 13 in half B/half A)
Note: For A squares, begin with A and use throughout.
Row 1 (half B/half A square): With B, ch 3, 3 dc in 3rd ch from hook (one shell made) ch 3, turn.
Row 2: 3 dc in 3rd ch from hook, slip st in ch-3 space of first shell, ch 3, 3 dc in same ch-3 space, ch 3, turn—2 shells.
Row 3: 3 dc in 3rd ch from hook, *slip st in ch-3 space of next shell, ch 3, 3 dc in same ch-3 space; repeat from * across, ch 3, turn—3 shells.
Rows 4-7: Repeat Row 3. At end of Row 7, do not ch 3, turn, slip st in each st across shell, slip st into ch-3 space of shell, fasten off B—7 shells.
Row 8: With A, slip st in ch-3 space of same shell, ch 3, 3 dc in same ch-3 space, *slip st in ch-3 of next shell, ch 3, 3 dc in same ch-3 space; repeat from * across to last shell, end with slip st in last ch-3 space, turn, slip st in each st across shell.
Rows 9-13: Repeat Row 8 until 1 shell remains, fasten off.
FISH (make 6 in C and 6 in D)
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as dc), 10 dc in 4th ch from hook, join with slip st to first ch—11 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, 2 dc in each dc around, join, do not fasten off—22 dc.
Tail: Ch 4, 8 dc in same space as joining, ch 3, turn, slip st in first dc, slip st in each dc across tail, ch 3, slip st in same dc, fasten off.
Mouth: Join E in 11th dc of body with slip st, (ch 4, slip st, ch 4, slip st) in same st, fasten off.

BLANKET (Blanket is worked lengthwise)
With Tunisian hook and A, ch 146 loosely.
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 146 sts on hook. Do not turn.
Return pass: ( Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook. Do not turn.

2nd to 5th rows: Forward pass: ( Right to left). *1Tss in next st. Rep from * end of row. Do not turn. Return pass.

6th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With A, draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 146 sts on hook. Do not turn. Drop A. Join B. Return pass with B.

7th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With B, draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 146 sts on hook. Do not turn. Drop B. Join A. Return pass with A.

8th to 11th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice more. Break B at end of last row.

12th to 17th rows: With A, as 2nd row.
Rep 6th to 17th rows for Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 46" [117 cm] (width of Blanket), ending on a 17th row of Stripe Pat. Fasten off.

Side Facing: 1st row: (RS). With U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook, join A with sl st in bottom right corner of Blanket. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Working in back loop only of each st across last row of Blanket, work 1 row of dc evenly along side edge to opposite corner. Fasten off.

Fold Facing to WS of Blanket, pin in position and whip stitch in place (this will prevent curling edges).
Rep along opposite side in back loops only of first row of Blanket.

Block side edges of Blanket by pinning onto a flat surface, covering with a damp cloth and allowing cloth to dry.

Fringe
Cut strands of A and B 14" [35.5 cm] long. Taking 3 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe across both ends of Blanket, matching fringe to Stripe Pat (see photo). Trim fringe evenly.

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G = Color A, B, C, D, E, F, and G

measurements: Doll measures 16” tall.
gauge: 20 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD AND BODY
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 8–15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc2tog] 15 times—15 sts.
Rounds 17–19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 7 times, sc in last sc—22 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times; change to B in last sc—24 sc.
Undershirt
Rounds 22–27: With B, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc of Round 27.
Waist
Rounds 28 and 29: With A, sc in each sc around; change to B in last sc of Round 29.
Begin Knickers
Rounds 30–35: With B, sc in each sc around. Do not fasten off. Stuff body firmly.
Joining Row: Flatten lower edging, matching stitches. Working through both thicknesses, sc across to close lower edge. Fasten off B.
ARM (make 2)
Beginning at top of arm, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 3–19: Sc in each sc, stuffing arm as you go.
Round 20: [Sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—6 sc.
Round 21: Work 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Sc in each sc around.
Round 25: [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last sc—5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff arm. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull gently to close opening. Draw a strand of A through arm at elbow and pull to form elbow dimple. Sew arms to sides of body. With B, embroider a strap over each shoulder, from top front of undershirt to top back of undershirt.
EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew ears in place. 
Earrings (make 2)
Thread two beads onto heavy-duty sewing thread and sew to ear. Repeat for 2nd earring.
HAIR
Wrap F around 7” piece of heavy cardboard 150 times. Wrap E around same piece of cardboard 2 times. Cut one end of wraps. *Fold one strand in half, forming a loop at folded end. Insert hook around a stitch on head of doll at hairline. Place loop of folded strands on hook and draw through. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten; repeat from * around hairline, placing the E-colored strands on top of head on right side. Continue to repeat from * to fill in over back of head. Holding head firmly, brush hair with a hairbrush until desired texture is achieved. Trim ends to about shoulder length.
LEG (make 2)
Beginning at foot, with E, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc.
Round 4: With A, sc in next 6 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—15 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in each remaining sc around—10 sc.
Rounds 10–27: Sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you go; change to B in last sc.
Round 28: With B, sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Seam Toe
Flatten last row, matching stitches and ensuring that toe faces forward, sewing through both thicknesses, sew across.
Shoe Ties
With E, ch 50 (for first tie), slip st in top of shoe at center back, ch 50 (for 2nd tie). Fasten off. Criss-cross ties around leg and tie in a bow at front.
Sew legs to bottom of body.
MOBIUS SCARF
With C, ch 14.
Row 1: Work (sc, 2 dc) in 2nd ch from hook, *ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, 2 dc) in next ch; repeat from * across, turn—4 (sc, 2 dc) groups.
Row 2: Ch 1, (sc, 2 dc) in first dc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, (sc, 2 dc) in next dc; repeat from * across to last 2 sts, skip next dc, dc in last sc, turn.
Repeat last row until piece is long enough to wrap very loosely around dolls shoulders. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Place piece flat then flip one short edge over. Sew short edges together.
HAT
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 sc at the end of Round 3.
Round 4: Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] 11 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 sc.
Rounds 5–7: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
First Earflap
Note: Work now proceeds back and forth in rows.
Row 8: Ch 3, dc in next 7 dc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked—8 dc.
Row 9: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 4 times, turn—4 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 2 times, turn—2 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, ch 12 (for tie). Fasten off.
Second Earflap
Row 8: Skip next 8 unworked dc following first earflap, join B with sl st in next dc, ch 3, dc in next 7 dc, turn—8 dc.
Repeat Rows 9–12 of first earflap. Fasten off.
DRESS
Bodice
With D, ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—9 sc.
Rows 2–26: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across, turn. Do not turn at end of Row 26. Do not fasten off.
Skirt
Row 1: Working in ends of rows across side of bodice, sc in end of each row across; change to E in last sc, turn—26 sc.
Row 2: With E, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in first sc (increase made), 2 dc in each remaining sc across, turn—52 dc.
Rows 3–7: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn; change to D in last st of Row 7.
Row 8 (Right Side): With D and working in front loops only, ch 3, dc in first dc (increase made), 2 dc in each remaining dc across, turn—104 dc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in each dc across. Fasten off. 
Row 10: Working in free back loops of Row 7 (behind D-colored ruffle), join E with slip st in sc, ch 4 (counts as tr), tr in same sc (increase made), 2 tr in each remaining sc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 3, dc in each tr across.
Fasten off. Sew back seam using matching yarn colors.
Neck Ties
With D, ch 35 (for first tie), slip st in center top of bodice, ch 35 (for 2nd tie). Fasten off.
BAG
With B, ch 17.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, *dc in each of next 2 ch, sc in next 4 ch; repeat from * across, turn—16 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, *dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across; change to G in last st, turn. Do not fasten off B. Carry color not in use up side of piece until next needed.
Rows 3 and 4: With G, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next 3 sts, *sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across, turn; change to B in last st of Row 4.
Rows 5 and 6: With B, work Row 2 twice; change to G in last sc of Row 6.
Rows 7–14: Repeat Rows 3–6 two times.
Rows 15–17: Repeat Rows 3–5.
Row 18: With B, ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, dc in next 2 dc, sc in next 2 sc, ch 4 (for button loop), sc in next 2 sc, dc in next 2 dc, sc in last 4 sc. Fasten off.
Fold bag in half. Working through both thicknesses, join B with sc in one lower corner (at fold), sc evenly spaced up side edge, ch 30 (for strap); working through both thicknesses, sc down other side edge. Fasten off. Sew button opposite buttonhole.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Place clothing and accessories on doll.
Embroider Face
With G, embroider satin stitch eyes. With F, embroider couched stitch eyebrows. With A, embroider satin stitch nose. With D, embroider a couched stitch smile. With red crayon, gently rub color onto face for cheeks.
Bracelet
With D, ch 10, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last 2 ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Wrap bracelet around wrist of doll and sew ends together.

instructions:
BIRD

Body
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join rounds, work in a spiral, marking first st of each round, moving marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 3 times—21 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 3 times—24 sc.
Rounds 6-13: Sc in each sc around—24 sc.
Round 14: [Sc2tog in next 2 sts] twice, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog in next 2 sts—23 sc.
Round 15: [Sc2tog in next 2 sts] twice, sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 8 sc—24 sc
Round 16: [Sc2tog in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—18 sc. Start stuffing body.
Round 17: [Sc2tog in next 2 sts, sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 18: [Sc2tog in next 2 sts] around, slip st in next sc—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length. Weave sewing length through sts of last round, gather tightly and secure.

Wing (make 2)
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join rounds, work in a spiral as before.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: (Hdc, dc, tr) in next sc, 3 sc along the side of the tr just made, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times, sc in last sc
Round 4: 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving remaining sts unworked, and leaving a sewing length.

Beak
With F, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: 4 sc in ring—4 sc. Do not join rounds, work in a spiral as before.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] twice—6 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] twice, slip st in next sc—8 sc. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.

Tail
With C, ch 9. 
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next 5 ch, 4 sc in last sc, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 5 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, turn—18 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), working in back loops only, hdc in first 2 hdc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in each of the next 2 sc, sc in next 6 sc, hdc in last 2 hdc, turn—21 sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, working in back loops only, hdc in first 2 hdc, sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in each of the next 2 sc, sc in next 7 sc, hdc in last 2 hdc. Fasten off. Rounded end is base of tail.

ASSEMBLY
Sew bird together using matching yarn. With E, satin st 2 eyes on head. Weave in ends.

SMALL HEART (make 9)
First Half
With A, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join rounds, work in a spiral as before.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4-7: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. 
Second Half
Repeat Rounds 1-7. Do not fasten off.
Bottom
Joining row: With right sides of first and second half facing, working through double thickness, with wrong side of second half facing, slip st in each of next 4 sc. 
Round 8: 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in last sc—32 sc.

With smaller hook and D, ch 8. Taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining and in each ch around—8 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] twice—6 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc2tog] 5 times—3 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Knot securely, then weave tail back through nose to beginning round, to be used later for sewing nose to snowman. Stuff nose with a small amount of same colored yarn.

With larger hook and B, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Repeat last row until piece measures about 20” (51 cm) from beginning, or desired length. Fasten off, leaving a tail about 12” (30.5 cm) long for attaching to mini skein. Weave in and trim beginning yarn tail.
HAT
Ribbed Band
With larger hook and C, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—3 sc.
Rows 2-45: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Do not fasten off.
Body
Note: Color is changed to form stripes. Do not cut colors not in use until instructed. Carry colors not in use carefully up inside of the hat when next needed.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 46 sc evenly spaced across long edge of band; join with slip st in first sc to begin working in rounds—46 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Change to B.
Rounds 3 and 4: With B, ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Change to D.
Round 5: With D, ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Change to C.
Round 6: With C, ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Change to B.
Round 7: With B, ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Change to D.
Rounds 8-13: Repeat Rounds 5-7 twice.
Round 14: With D, ch 1, *[sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * once more; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Change to B.
Round 15: With B, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc. Change to C.
Round 16: With C, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc. Change to D. Cut C.
Round 17: With D, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc. Change to B. Cut D.
Round 18: With B, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 19: With B, [sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Knot securely, weave in and trim tail. With beginning tail of ribbed band, sew ends of band together. Weave in and trim tail.
Pompoms
Cut 12” (30.5 cm) length of any color yarn and set aside. Hold three fingers extended and close together. Wrap D around fingers 40 times, then wrap C around fingers 40 times, and finally wrap B around fingers 40 times, for a total of 120 wraps.
While wraps are still on fingers, slip the 12” (30.5 cm) yarn length under the wraps and slip the wraps off your fingers. Tie 12” (30.5 cm) length tightly around wraps. Hold yarn wraps tightly in fist with 12” (30.5 cm) tie dangling from bottom of fist and the looped wraps extending over top of closed fist. Using sharp craft scissors, carefully trim loops to form pompom. Grasp pompom by 12” (30.5 cm) tie and shake to fluff out. Make another pompom identical to the first. With the 12” (30.5 cm) ties, tie the two pompoms together. Leaving ends of ties free, apply a moderate amount of craft glue to knot and let dry. With ties and yarn needle attach pompom to hat.
MINI SKEIN OF YARN
Cut two 12” (30.5 cm) lengths of any color yarn and set aside. Hold four fingers extended and slightly spread. Wrap yarn color of your choice around fingers 50 times. While wraps are still on fingers, slip one of the 12” (30.5 cm) length under the wraps and slip the wraps off your fingers. Knot 12” (30.5 cm) length tightly around wraps.
Hold wraps by tie and smooth out yarn so that it hangs straight. Slip second tie through opposite end of wraps and knot around wraps tightly. Apply a moderate amount of craft glue to knots and let dry. Weave ends through skein and trim. Set aside.
Label
Make a copy of the mini Red Heart label. If needed, reduce image size to fit mini skein. Then print image on color printer. To reinforce label use clear cellophane tape placed carefully over image or image can be laminated. Trim label width and length to fit skein, wrap around middle of skein and tape securely.
FINISHING
Note: Whenever possible, use yarn tails still attached to pieces to sew the pieces in place. Using photograph as a guide, sew arms to shoulders of snowman near beginning of cardigan sweater. Sew hat to head. Sew nose to lower portion of head. With sewing needle and black thread, sew eyes above nose, and sew four black buttons evenly spaced down the button band of the cardigan sweater. Place crochet hook in palm of one hand. Sew hand closed around the hook. Place small amount of glue where hand grips the hook for extra security. Tie scarf around neck, so that end of scarf with long yarn tail falls in front. Tack scarf in place using matching yarn, as desired. Insert plastic hook through a couple loops at end of scarf. Wrap the long yarn tail around throat of hook (as if making a yarn over) then tie the tail to one end of the mini skein and weave loose end into the skein. Glue the “stitches” wrapped around the hook in place using craft glue. Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 319 Cherry Red A, 706 Perfect Pink B, 316 Soft White C, 321 Gold D, 661 Frosty Green E.
Crochet Hooks: 4.25 mm [US G-6] and 5.5 mm [US I-9] (for scarf and hat only).
Yarn needle, stuffing, stitch marker, one pair 9-12 mm safety eyes, 3 x 4” piece of heavy cardboard (for making hat tassels), pins.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, and E = Color A, B, C, D, and E
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Penguin measures 14” tall, not including hat.
gauge: 18 sts = 4”; 20 rows = 4” in single crochet with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD AND BODY
Beginning at top of head, with smaller hook and A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Rounds 9–20: Sc in each sc around.
Round 21: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—42 sts.
Round 22: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 23: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 24: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 25: Sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes between Rounds 16 and 17.
Rounds 26–28: Repeat Rounds 5–7—42 sc.
Rounds 29–31: Sc in each sc around.
Round 32: Repeat Round 8—48 sc.
Round 33: Sc in each sc around.
Round 34: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 35: Sc in each sc around.
Round 36: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times—60 sc.
Rounds 37–57: Sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing piece, and continue to stuff until piece is complete.
Round 58: [Sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—54 sts.
Round 59: [Sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—48 sts.
Rounds 60–63: Repeat Rounds 21–24—24 sts.
Round 64: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sts.
Round 65: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round. Pull to close opening. Securely weave in end.

CHEST PIECE
With smaller hook and C, ch 14.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; change to B, turn—13 sc.
Row 2: With B, ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times, sc in last sc, turn—16 sc.
Row 3: With B, ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times; change to C, turn—20 sc.
Row 4: With C, ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times, turn—24 sc.
Row 5: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc across; change to B, turn.
Rows 6–17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across and continue to change color every other row, turn.
Row 18: With B, ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times, turn—28 sc.
Row 19: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc across; change to C, turn.
Rows 20–37: Ch 1, sc in each sc across and continue to change color every other row, turn.
Row 38: With B, ch 1, [sc2tog] 2 times, sc in next 20 sc, [sc2tog] 2 times—24 sc.
Edging: With B, ch 1, sc evenly spaced around edges of entire piece; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing to body.

FLIPPERS (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 20; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around—20 sts. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–15: Hdc in next 10 sts, sc in last 10 sts.
Round 16: Sc in next 10 sts, hdc in last 10 sts.
Rounds 17–19: Hdc in each st around.
Round 20: [Hdc in next 3 hdc, hdc2tog] 4 times—16 hdc.
Round 21: [Hdc in next 2 hdc, hdc2tog] 4 times—12 hdc.
Round 22: [Hdc in next hdc, hdc2tog] 4 times—8 hdc.
Round 23: [Hdc2tog] 4 times—4 hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Do not stuff flipper. Thread tail through stitches of last round. Pull to close opening. Securely weave in end.

BEAK
With smaller hook and D, ch 17; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around—17 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: Sc in next sc, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 4 times—13 sts.
Round 4: Sc in next sc, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—9 sts.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round. Pull to close opening. Securely weave in end. Stuff beak lightly.

FEET (make 2)
With smaller hook and D, ch 11.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across to last ch, 2 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next sc and in each sc across; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Rounds 2–5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 4 times—16 sc.
Rounds 7–11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 13: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Do not stuff feet.

SCARF
With larger hook and E, ch 62. 
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—60 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in each st across.
Fasten off. Weave in tail.

HAT
With larger hook and E, ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—11 sc.
Rows 2–31: Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. With tail, sew short edges together to form a tube. Flatten the piece, and working through both thicknesses, slip st across top edge to seam crown of hat.
Tassels (make 2): Wrap yarn around piece of heavy cardboard about 25 times. Thread a 12” strand of yarn under the top of the wraps and tie a knot to secure. Slip wraps from cardboard. Wrap a 10” strand of yarn around the wraps several times, about ½” below the top tie for tassel neck. Tie ends of strand to secure and thread ends to inside of tassel. Cut ends of wraps, trim to desired length. With ends of top tie, tie one tassel to each top corner of hat. Knot the ties securely on the inside of hat.

FINISHING
Sew flippers to side edges near top of chest piece. Pin chest piece to body and sew in place. Sew beak to face, centered between eyes. Sew feet to bottom of penguin. Weave in any remaining ends. Tie scarf around neck and place hat on head.

Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same sc as join, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.

Round 6: *Ch 9, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next 5 ch (beginning of first leaf), skip next 3 sc of Round 5, slip st in next sc, TURN, skip slip st just made; working across leaf sts, sc in next 7 sts of leaf, 3 sc in next sc (tip of leaf); work 8 sc evenly spaced across opposite side of ch-9, slip st in st at base of ch-9, TURN, skip slip st just made, sc in next sc, hdc in next 2 sc, dc in next 5 sc, 5 dc in next sc, dc in next 5 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, sc in next sc, slip st in last sc of leaf, slip st in next 2 sc of Round 5; repeat from * 2 more times. Rnd 3: Join 2nd color in any ch-1 space; (Beg PS, ch 4, PS) all in same space, * ch 1, [PS in next ch-1 space, ch 1] 3 times **, (PS, ch 4, PS) all in next ch-1 space for corner; repeat from * around, end at **; join – 20 puff sts. Fasten off.
Rnds 4 and 5: Join next color in any corner ch-4 space; (Beg PS, ch 4, PS) all in same space, * ch 1, PS in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to next corner; ch 1 **, (PS, ch 4, PS) all in corner ch-4 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.

Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 95 sc.

With Ivory and right sides of squares together, slip st squares in a 3 x 4 rectangle. Fold in half and slip st sides together. Sew ends of straps to top opening of bag at seams on each side of center top square.

Felting is not an exact science due to the many different variables, however approximately 30% of the dimensions may be lost in the felting process.
Place bag and 1 or 2 bath towels in the washing machine in the smallest load with hottest water setting and a small amount of liquid detergent through two wash cycles. Do not use fabric softener. Top Panel
With larger hook and A, ch 17.

2nd to 14th rows: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.

Sides
Begin working in rnds as follows:
15th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Work 14 sc evenly along first side of Panel. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 16 ch. Work 14 sc evenly along other side of Panel. Join. 60 sc.
16th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around. Join. 60 hdc.
17th and 18th rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops,  1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off at end of last rnd.

Hat Brim: 19th rnd: With I and K held tog, join with sl st in front loop of first hdc. Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 dc in each st around. Join. Fasten off. 60 dc.

Head
20th rnd: Join [B for Santa and Elf or E for Reindeer] with sl st to rem back loop of 18th rnd join. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each st around. Join. 60 hdc.
21st to 27th rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 hdc in each st around. Join.
Your cover should be half way down the length of your tissue box. This is where the tissues will poke out from under the nose at the front of the Cover. If not, add or remove rows as needed. Put cover on box and decide which side will be the front. PM for 8 center hdc of front for tissue slot.

Tissue Slot: 28th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to first marker. Ch 8. Skip next 8 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. 52 hdc and 1 ch-8 sp.
29th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 hdc in each st and ch around. Join. 60 hdc.

Bottom
Santa and Elf Only: 30th to 32nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each st around. Join. Fasten off at end of 32nd rnd.
Body Trim: 33rd rnd: With I and K held tog, join with sl st in front loop of first hdc. Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 dc in each st around. Join. Fasten off. 60 dc.
34th rnd:  Join [A for Santa or C for Elf] with sl st to rem back loop of 32nd rnd join. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 60 hdc.
35th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.

Reindeer Only: 30th to 32nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each st around. Join. Fasten off at end of  32nd rnd.

EARRINGS & NECKLACE
WEB (Make 3; 1 for each Earring and 1 for Necklace)
With A, make an adjustable loop ring.
Round 1: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3), [dc in ring, ch 3] 5 times, slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch – 6 dc and ch-3 spaces. Tighten beginning loop.

With B, make an adjustable loop ring.
Round 1: Ch 2, work 20 hdc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch. Tighten beginning loop.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in next 3 hdc, ch 6, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 4 ch, sc in same hdc (first spider leg), sc in next 2 hdc, ch 5, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 3 ch, sc in same hdc (second spider leg), sc in next 2 hdc, ch 4, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 2 ch, sc in same hdc (third spider leg), sc in next 3 hdc, ch 2, sc in same hdc, sc in next 2 hdc, ch 2, sc in next 3 hdc (spider mouth), ch 4, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 2 ch, sc in same hdc (fourth spider leg), sc in next 2 hdc, ch 5, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 3 ch, sc in same hdc (fifth spider leg), sc in next 2 hdc, ch 6, slip st in second ch from hook and in next 4 ch, sc in same hdc (sixth spider leg), sc in last hdc, slip st in beginning ch, ch 12 for Earrings or 250 ch for Necklace. Attach ear wire hooks to top edge.

instructions:
SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS
2-Chain Picot (2-ch-picot) = Ch 2, insert hook in front loop (horizontal bar) of the sc just made and in the left strand (vertical bar) of the same st, yo and pull through all three loops.
3-Chain Picot (3-ch-picot) = Ch 3, insert hook in front loop (horizontal bar) of the dc just made and in the left strand (vertical bar) of the same st, yo and pull through all three loops.
Note: Join rounds with a slip stitch. The leaf is made by working around both sides of the starting chain, keeping the right side facing.

CLEMATIS
Flower Center: 
With C and 6 mm hook, ch 2; [sc in to second ch from the hook, 2-ch-picot] 8 times; join to first sc and fasten off – 8 2-ch picots.

Petals
Round 1: 
Working into the back loops of the flower center with the 8 mm hook, join A in the back loop of a sc; slip st into sc; [ch 5, slip st in back hump of second ch from the hook and in back hump of next 3 ch, slip st into next sc] 7 times; ch 5, slip st in back hump of second ch from the hook and in back hump of next 3 ch; slip st into first slip st – 8 ch-5 petals.
Round 2: 
Work into the back loops of the ch-5 petals; [slip st into the first chain of the petal, sc in the next st, hdc in the next st, dc in the next st, (3 dc, 3-ch-picot, 3 dc) in the back loop of the turning chain at tip of petal, dc in the first slip st, hdc in the next st, sc in the next st, slip st in the next st, slip st into the slip st between the petals] 8 times – 8 petals.
Fasten off and weave in the ends.

Leaves (Make 2)
Center Vein:
With B and 8 mm hook, ch 6; working into the back hump of the chains, slip st in the second ch from the hook, slip st in next 4 ch, ch 1 – 5 slip st.
Round 1:
Starting on the opposite side and working into the back loops of the center vein; slip st in the first ch, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, (3 dc, 3-ch-picot, 3 dc) in back loop of turning ch at tip of leaf; working down the slip st side, dc in next 2 slip st, hdc in next slip st, sc in next slip st, slip st in last slip st; join.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

Backing
Round 1:
With A and 8 mm hook, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2:
Ch1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3:
Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc; [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 5 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4:
Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc; [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 5 times; join to first sc – 24 sc.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

Felting
Before assembling the flower, put the pieces into pillowcases and tie closed. Place them in a washing machine with hot water and a small amount of detergent. Check during the wash cycle regularly until desired amount of felting is achieved. Rinse soap and squeeze out excess water. Slightly overlap the clematis petals, pin into place and let dry. Block remaining pieces into desired shapes and let dry.

ASSEMBLY
Arrange two leaves on the back of flower; pin into place and stitch to the clematis with B. Place backing on the clematis over the leaves; pin and stitch into place with A. Sew bar pin onto back.

Repeat Row 2 and continue to change color as in Stripe Sequence #1, until all 26 rows are worked. Fasten off.
PILLOW #2
Work same as Pillow #1, changing color as in Stripe Sequence #2.
FINISHING
With matching color yarn, sew straight side edges of the piece together to form a tube. Flatten the tube, with seam at one side edge. Weave in ends.

dc2tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Stripe Sequence #1
Work 1 row with A, 1 row with B, 1 row with A, 4 rows with C, 1 row with A, 1 row with B, 1 row with A, 6 rows with E, 1 row with A, 1 row with B, 1 row with A, 4 rows with D, 1 row with A, 1 row with B, 1 row with A.
Stripe Sequence #2
Work 4 rows with D, 4 rows with E, 3 rows with C, 1 row with A, 2 rows with B, 1 row with A, 3 rows with C, 4 rows with E, 4 rows D.

Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 dc.

Note: Remainder of cocoon is worked back and forth in rows.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in same st as join, [skip next 2 dc, shell in next dc, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc] 10 times, skip next 2 dc, shell. Cocoon measures 22” (56 cm) circumference and 18” (45.5 cm) long. Hat measures 15” (38 cm) circumference (just before Lg-shell round)
Special Stitches
shell = (Dc, [ch 1, dc] 3 times) in indicated stitch.
Lg-shell (Large shell) = (Dc, [ch 1, dc] 4 times) in indicated stitch.
Ltr (Linked treble crochet) = Insert hook in upper horizontal bar of previous Ltr (or tr), yarn over and pull up a loop (2 loops on hook), insert hook in next horizontal bar of same Ltr (or tr), yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop (4 loops on hook), [yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook] 3 times.
Ltr-shell (Linked treble crochet shell) = (Tr, 4 Ltr, ch 2, tr, 4 Ltr) in indicated stitch.
extsc (extended single crochet) = Insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through 1 loop on hook, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook.
Bpextsc (Back post extended single crochet) = Insert hook from back to front and to back again around post of indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through 1 loop on hook, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook.
extsc2tog (extended single crochet 2 together) = Insert hook in front loop of next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
sc2tog (single crochet 2 together) = [Insert hook in next stitch and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
